title: For Server Developers
excerpt: In this tutorial, we'll build a simple MCP weather server and connect it to a host, Claude for Desktop. We'll start with a basic setup, and then progress to more complex use cases. What we'll be building Many LLMs do not currently have the ability to fetch the forecast and severe weather alerts. Let's use MCP to solve that!
